definition: [ כְּלַל ] verb complete (see Biblical Hebrew I. [ כָּלַל ]; but ׳ שַׁכ perhaps loan-word from Assyrian šuklulu , ušaklil, uštaklil , DI WB 331, compare שֵׁיוֵב , שֵׁיצֵא and Buhl 14 ); — Shaph`el of building: Perfect 3 masculine singular suffix שַׁכְלְלֵהּ Ezra 5:11 he finished it ; 3 masculine plural שַׁכְלִלוּ Ezra 6:14 , also (with accusative of thing) Ezra 4:12 ( Kt שׁודי אשׁכללו , read Qr ) ׳ שׁוּרַיָא שׁ ; Infinitive לְהַשְׁכְּלָלָה , accusative of thing Ezra 5:3 ; Ezra 5:9 . Ishtaph. be completed , of walls; Imperfect 3 masculine plural יִשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן Ezra 4:13 ; Ezra 4:16 .
